blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: compiler — Translates high-level source into target code.
interpreter — Runs a program through an execution runtime.
assembler — Translates assembly to machine encoding.

blocks.title: Understand
blocks.text: A compiler translates source code into another representation, often creating executable machine code via linking.

blocks.title: Apply
blocks.text: An interpreter executes program statements with a runtime, often without a separate standalone compiled executable.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: An assembler translates assembly mnemonics and operands into processor machine instructions; translation strategies can overlap in modern environments.
